subject: Offsite workshop — venue floorplan, AV checklist & call-bridge plan
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Rachel Park <rachel@hiltonsfevents.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-03-08 09:12 PST
Subject: Offsite workshop — venue floorplan, AV checklist & call-bridge plan

Team —

We have the Acme executive + technical day at the Hilton SF on 2026-04-14. I want to lock the room layout, AV scope, and remote call-bridge configuration this week so procurement can finalize the venue SOW by Friday. High-level asks:

- Main workshop (9:00–17:00): theatre-style for first half (exec presentations) then move to U-shaped pods for hands-on labs (40 people).
- We need a reliable SIP+WebRTC bridge for two remote execs in EMEA — low jitter, 1080p spot.
- Recording of morning keynote + local livestream (internal only).

Marissa / Rachel: can you confirm recommended room(s) + back-of-house access?
Dev / CloudAV (cc): can you outline AV kit minimums and whether the venue's house system is sufficient or we should bring a local rig?

Attaching the initial floorplan and a working AV checklist. Please update in-line. If we can get a single doc with equipment list, run-of-show, and contact list by Thursday EOD I can push SOW to procurement.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: 02_floorplan_v1.pdf (sketch), av_checklist_v3.xlsx (work-in-progress)

From: Rachel Park <rachel@hiltonsfevents.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-03-08 11:03 PST
Subject: Re: Offsite workshop — venue floorplan, AV checklist & call-bridge plan

Hi Hannah / Marissa —

Thanks for the details. The Redwood room block (Grand Marina, Rooms A+B) fits up to 60 with flexible seating and a dedicated green room. Back-of-house access via loading dock on 3rd Street is open 07:00–20:00.

Our house AV includes:
- Two ceiling line-array speakers (coverage for Grand A+B)
- Dual HD projectors with HDMI switching
- One Crestron touch panel
- Wired network (100 Mbps burst) and dedicated VLANs on request

For recording + a secure enterprise bridge, we recommend two options:
1) Use hotel house system + CloudAV-managed bridge over a dedicated VLAN (recommended for cost).
2) Bring CloudAV's dedicated encoder and managed 4K switcher if you need multi-venue redundancy (higher cost).

I will pencil Rooms A+B for 8:00–18:00 on 2026-04-14 pending SOW. I can provide a full AV quote and insurance rider by Thursday if you confirm scope.

Regards,
Rachel Park
Director, Event Services — Hilton SF Events
rachel@hiltonsfevents.com
(415) 555-0104

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Rachel Park <rachel@hiltonsfevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com>, CloudAV Productions <ops@cloudav.co>
Date: 2026-03-08 13:18 PST
Subject: Re: Offsite workshop — venue floorplan, AV checklist & call-bridge plan

Thanks Rachel — that looks workable. A few notes from infra/engineering perspective: 

- Network: we need a dedicated VLAN with static IPs for the bridge endpoints. Hotel VLAN must support persistent port mappings. If the house network cannot guarantee this, we'll bring a 4G backup for the bridge.
- Media: For the hands-on lab we need 4 local demo stations with HDMI mirroring to the main display for in-room instructor monitoring. Can the Crestron route four HDMI inputs to the switcher?
- Recording: We'll record the keynote at 1080p30, local file saved to an encrypted drive.

CloudAV (ops): please confirm codec and SIP trunk options, and add an equipment list and day-of staffing plan. Prefer a small on-site engineer + remote ops monitor.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0129

From: ops@cloudav.co <ops@cloudav.co>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Rachel Park <rachel@hiltonsfevents.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-03-08 16:45 PST
Subject: Re: Offsite workshop — venue floorplan, AV checklist & call-bridge plan

Hi team —

CloudAV confirms availability for 2026-04-14. Short summary:

- Equipment we will provide: 1x 4-input HD encoder (SRT/SIP), 1x hardware MCU for SIP interop, 2x wireless lapel mics, 1x backup encoder, 1x field audio mixer, 1x on-site engineer (07:00–19:00).
- Bridge details: carrier SIP trunking with regex-based failover to WebRTC gateway. We can provision static public IPs and provide our own NAT traversal.
- Call quality: we will run a 15-minute test with Acme execs one week prior.

Provisional cost estimate attached; final SOW after confirmation of VLAN needs and acceptance of hotel insurance rider.

Best,
CloudAV Operations
ops@cloudav.co
Attachment: callbridge_config.txt (SIP/codec notes)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rachel Park <rachel@hiltonsfevents.com>, CloudAV Productions <ops@cloudav.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmecorp.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-03-09 15:34 PST
Subject: Re: Offsite workshop — venue floorplan, AV checklist & call-bridge plan

All —

This is great, thank you both. Quick decisions so procurement can finalize SOW:

1) Use hotel house AV with CloudAV-managed bridge (option 1).
2) Redwood will provide encrypted recording drive and 4G backup for the bridge.
3) CloudAV will run a 15-minute connectivity test with Acme on 2026-04-07 09:00 PST — Jordan, can you confirm that works for your team?
4) Rachel — please include a VLAN request in the SOW (static IP block and port mappings) and attach the hotel insurance rider.

Marissa / Steph — I'll route this to procurement now. Once SOW is signed, can we lock a site walk for the Redwood on-site ops + one Acme technical contact the week of 2026-04-06?

Thanks — Hannah
